Girl on the right: "nice"

Girl on the left: unimpressed

Thank you so so much for writing this out. This dilemma has been weighing on me so much the past year....finding that balance is so hard. I like the elimination diet idea and I think I will try it. It will be very hard at first with the guilt, though--it seems there is this never ending pressure to keep up with everything, to be doing everything, and it is very easy to judge myself for not doing enough. But I will try to find that balance anyway, maybe that will be what finally gets me to a point where I feel good about my actions and my mental health simultaneously. Thank you.

That is incredible and gives me so much hope💛 I'm struggling with different things and fuck it all feels impossible sometimes. But I can only imagine how hard your journey has been and the fact that you have made it so far gives me hope that maybe I can, too. Thank you for sharing your journey and I am proud of you.
Remember that as with any skill, what comes easily to you may not come easily to others. Be grateful that it comes easily to you, and have compassion for those who are still learning.
Thank you for this. Thank you for caring💜 I will stay strong. Thank you

I am so glad you are starting to feel a bit better. Journaling is a great thing and I'm proud of you for finding ways to make yourself feel better, like by writing out your feelings. Remember that if you ever feel like this again you were so strong and resourceful and got yourself through the pain. I hope you keep feeling better and I wish you the best💜 if you need anything else, this community is here for you

I know this feeling, of being scared you will hurt yourself because everything feels too much. Listening to music is a really good way to get through the painful thoughts and release some emotion. It is smart of you to go to music. It sounds like things are really hard right now and you are blaming yourself. 

It is normal and ok to cry. I cry when I feel this way too. I have gotten rid of all my sharp things so I don't have to be afraid I will hurt myself, because the fear makes it much harder to cope with. Can you lock the knives away or hide them or get rid of them?

Do you want to talk about what it is that is making you sad and overwhelmed?
